title: CLUTCH CONTROL SHAFT & RELEASE BEARING
summary: Manual-transmission clutch linkage: the clutch cross shaft (clutch lever asm [11], 'Z-bar') pivots on stud asm [12] at the engine end and on ball stud [2] at the frame end, where the stud goes through the frame bracket with seat [1], retainer [8], seal [7], special washer [5] and nut [6] (ears bent over the nut). Rod [9] (clutch pushrod) runs from the cross shaft to the clutch fork with return springs [4]; it is held at the shaft by retainer [16] and at the fork by special pin [15] and cotter pin [14]. View A shows the clutch fork on its ball stud in the bellhousing and the release (throwout) bearing [13] on the transmission main shaft, greased per the notes.

ball stud [2] / cross shaft ball seat at the frame end

fastening.to: engine block (inboard end of cross shaft)
fastening.note: Stud asm [12] with its nut is the inboard pivot for the cross shaft [11].

fastening.to: frame bracket (outboard end of cross shaft)
fastening.note: Ball stud [2] carries seat [1], retainer [8] and seal [7] on the shaft side, passes through the frame bracket slot, and is clamped from the outside by special washer [5] and nut [6]. NOTE: bend the washer ears over the nut to prevent rotation. The outboard end of [11] (with its own seat [1]) snaps onto the ball.
Rod [9] end goes through the cross shaft arm hole and is held by spring clip retainer [16].

fastening.to: outer end of the clutch fork (View A)
fastening.note: Special pin [15] drops through the fork end and rod clevis; cotter pin [14] underneath.

fastening.to: rod [9] and the cross shaft / frame bracket
fastening.note: Two return springs [4] hook between rod [9] and the brackets at each end of the rod.

fastening.to: clutch fork on the transmission main shaft bearing retainer (View A)
fastening.note: Release bearing [13] slides on the transmission main shaft retainer and is held by the clutch fork fingers; fork pivots on a ball stud (no callout).

notes: NOTE Bend ears over nut to prevent rotation.
NOTE Fill this groove with lubricant for full circumference; apply with special gun.
B: Brush a uniform layer of lubricant to these surfaces for full circumference.
